beats.what: Lynn's father refuses the scholarship money and orders her to give it all back to Grace, leaving Lynn in tears
Grace corners Lynn over a drink, insists she is a real friend and not acting, and gets nothing back
At dinner Pat's father offers to send Lynn to Boston with Pat if she tutors him, and his mother slides over the university brochure
Grace explains the STIC: one exam sat worldwide, and they must pass it this year or they cannot apply
Grace names Pat's price of 600,000 baht and Lynn picks up the envelope
Waiting at a hotel desk, Lynn reads the wall of world clocks and realises Sydney runs hours ahead of Bangkok
Lynn pins Australia on a map and pitches sitting STIC in Sydney, selling the answers back to Bangkok students and splitting the profits
Lynn says she will memorise the answers so no evidence exists, admits she can only hold half, and names the one person who could cover the rest
Men waiting in a parked car jump Bank on his laundry round and dump him beaten and bloodied on a landfill
On the school roof a classmate sets the price at 150,000 baht a head and shows a STIC group chat with thirty clients already waiting
The classmate gloats that Bank was beaten into hospital and will miss the exam, and Lynn realises why he was attacked
The trio stage a fake STIC seminar for the paying clients and lay out the method: a phone hidden under the exam-hall sink, answers sent out during the two breaks
Lynn and Pat demonstrate the barcode: each answer encoded as stripe thickness printed along the clients' 2B pencils
Pat sets the rules - clear the drop point by 7:30, private motorbikes to the exam site, pay within two weeks, and tell nobody
